Today’s issue: The sock drawer, a sorting guide, and one pair too many.

The Main Thing

Every drawer has a missing sock. We went looking.

  • Fold, don’t roll.
  • Pair before you put away.

Spot the Bug

function sortPile(pile) { return pile.sort() }

Solution

  1. Copy the pile first.

The fix: copy the pile first, so the sorter doesn’t mutate the original pile.
